tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Discover provider IDs supported by Narev. Use these IDs to filter models or look up provider rates. Use list_gateways to discover gateway IDs.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Find model IDs for pricing lookups and cost estimates. Omit the provider filter to browse the catalog or pass comma-separated IDs from list_providers. Start at page 1 with 100 results by default and use meta.total_pages to continue.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Look up catalog rates for a model at its provider. Use get_gateway_prices for a gateway quote, get_price_tiers for region or service-mode rates, and calculate_cost for a usage total. An empty page means no matches. Null pricing means rates are unavailable.

tools.name: list_gateways
tools.description: Discover gateway IDs for get_gateway_prices. The response includes display names and base URLs when available. Use list_providers for the provider catalog.

tools.name: get_gateway_prices
tools.description: Look up model rates through OpenRouter or Kilo. Select a gateway ID from list_gateways and optionally narrow by provider or model. Omit the gateway to compare both. Use get_prices for provider catalog rates.

tools.name: get_price_tiers
tools.description: Find rates and volume bands for a region or service mode such as batch or priority. Combine filters to narrow the offer. Each band has a minimum and may have a maximum and a cost. Use get_prices for standard provider catalog rates.

tools.name: calculate_cost
tools.description: Estimate the USD total for a provider and model using measured token counts. Pass usage as reported by the provider, including cache, reasoning, and search counts when available. An unavailable rate returns an error. Use get_prices to inspect rates when usage is unknown.

tools.name: search_narev_docs
tools.description: Search Narev documentation for guides, API references, and code examples. Returns contextual excerpts and page links. For the full page, pass the returned path with a .mdx extension to query_docs_filesystem_narev_docs.

tools.name: query_docs_filesystem_narev_docs
tools.description: Read full pages or search exact text in the read-only Narev documentation filesystem. Discover paths with tree / -L 2 and read .mdx files with head or cat. Use search_narev_docs for broad questions. OpenAPI specs are under /openapi. Calls are stateless and output is capped at 30 KB, so use targeted

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Send a documentation issue to the Narev docs team. Provide the page path and explain what is wrong or missing. Use this only when the user wants to report a documentation issue. For product support, direct the user to support.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "query_docs_filesystem_narev_docs" appears informational but accepts parameters (command) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.narev.ai" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_gateways · Private data: calculate_cost, query_docs_filesystem_narev_docs · Public sink: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_gateways · Private data: calculate_cost, query_docs_filesystem_narev_docs · Public sink: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
